scripts.contracts: pnpm --filter @agentbridge/contracts run generate && pnpm run contracts:drift
scripts.lint: eslint . && prettier --check . && tsc -b && pnpm --filter @agentbridge/console run typecheck
scripts.check: pnpm run lint && pnpm run test && pnpm run contracts
scripts.test-python: node contracts/scripts/gen-vectors.mjs && cd sdk/python && python -m unittest discover -s tests
scripts.infra-synth: pnpm --filter @agentbridge/infra exec tsc -b && pnpm --filter @agentbridge/infra exec cdk synth -c ownerPublicKey=$AGENTBRIDGE_OWNER_PUBLIC_KEY
